parameters.name: p
parameters.description:
Page number (1-based). Selects page mode; mutually exclusive with after
and before.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description:
Items per page. Defaults to 20, max 100 (larger values are clamped and
echoed as page_size).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor: the page after this position. Pass a previous response's
next_cursor.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor: the page before this position. Pass a previous response's
prev_cursor.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description:
Whether to count matching rows. Default: exact in page mode, none in
cursor mode.

title.description: Localized by Accept-Language; English: "This agent cannot be assigned to an organization or outlet."

WhatsAppSystemAgentUnavailableProblem.description: WHATSAPP_SYSTEM_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE (503): Message sending is temporarily unavailable. Try again later. Retryable.

type.description: Problem type URI, one-to-one with code; documentation only, never dereferenced at runtime.

title.description: Localized by Accept-Language; English: "Message sending is temporarily unavailable. Try again later."

retry_after_ms.description: Retry delay hint in milliseconds; mirrors the Retry-After header.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Language of problem title/detail texts (RFC 9110 §12.5.4, RFC 4647 lookup). Supported: en, ms, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; zh-CN/zh-SG/zh → zh-Hans, zh-TW/zh-HK/zh-MO → zh-Hant; anything else falls back to en. Success responses never vary by language.

anyOf.description: Any weighted language-range list, e.g. "ms-MY, en;q=0.8".

CorrelationId.description: Correlation id of the request (the problem's correlation_id); the lookup key in logs and traces.

ProblemContentLanguage.description: Languages used in the problem text: the negotiated language, plus en when some text fell back to English (e.g. "ms, en").

ProblemVary.description: Always lists Accept-Language (merged with other tokens such as Accept-Encoding).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying; sent when the problem carries retry_after_ms.

Upgrade.description: <client>/<min_version> of the client release the server requires (e.g. gatherdeal-cli/1.4.0). No protocol switch is offered; act on code and details.min_version.
